name: ruby-hmac-webhook
title: Ruby HMAC webhook verifier
blurb: Ruby webhook signature verifier: Stripe-style HMAC-SHA256 signing, constant-time comparison and a timestamp tolerance window, stdlib only, minitest suite run by rake

verify.name: sign
verify.cmd: bin/{{ npm_name }} sign --secret whsec_dev --timestamp 1700000000 --payload hello | grep -q '^t=1700000000,v1=[0-9a-f]\{64\}$'

verify.name: verify-accepts-a-good-signature
verify.cmd: sig=$(bin/{{ npm_name }} sign --secret whsec_dev --timestamp 1700000000 --payload hello) && bin/{{ npm_name }} verify --secret whsec_dev --header "$sig" --payload hello --now 1700000000

verify.name: verify-rejects-a-stale-timestamp
verify.cmd: sig=$(bin/{{ npm_name }} sign --secret whsec_dev --timestamp 1700000000 --payload hello) && bin/{{ npm_name }} verify --secret whsec_dev --header "$sig" --payload hello --now 1700009999; test $? -eq 1

verify.name: stdin
verify.cmd: sig=$(printf 'hello' | bin/{{ npm_name }} sign --secret whsec_dev --timestamp 1700000000 --stdin) && printf 'hello' | bin/{{ npm_name }} verify --secret whsec_dev --header "$sig" --now 1700000000 --stdin
